description: metadata.authorizing_principal names a deontic principal and a mandate_ref, and carries no mandate_digest; no mandate.json is packaged. No signed mandate is claimed: every §4.5 check reports not determinate, nothing about the grant is verified, and the package stays accepted. This is the state §4.5 replaces.

reportIncludes: Authorizing principal named without a signed mandate: the deontic layer is a reference only and nothing in it is verified.
